first_impression: A dense browser wavetable synthesizer opens with an Init preset, many oscillator/effect controls, and a prominent CLICK TO START AUDIO button. The app is clearly an instrument editor with an AI activity control and walkthrough.
after_state: The screen remained on the Init preset and no visible control values or preset label changed.
notes: The synth and AI-ready activity affordance are visible, but I could not verify conversational AI sound design in this interaction.

first_impression: A queue of invoice records is shown with amounts, vendors, and review/approved statuses; invoice detail tabs are initially disabled. The workflow is recognizable as human invoice review.
action_attempted: Opened invoice INV-10231 from the review queue.
after_state: An Invoice page opened with Fields selected, extracted values and confidence percentages, plus Run match, Find duplicates, Flag issue, Comment, and Request decision actions.
notes: The detail view exposes audit-oriented controls and field-level Show buttons; no approval was attempted.

first_impression: The same live Countersign invoice-review queue presents review items and an approved item, with disabled detail tabs until an invoice is opened. The agent proposal/human countersign purpose is identifiable from the queue and review controls.
action_attempted: Opened the first invoice in the review queue.
after_state: Invoice fields appeared with confidence values and controls for matching, duplicate detection, issue flagging, comments, and requesting a decision; the state remained a review rather than an approval.
notes: This URL is shared with the other Countersign packet and exposes the same demonstrated workflow.

first_impression: A claims dashboard shows three claims with denial/settled status, billed amounts, and appeal-window information. The selected MRI claim displays insurer correspondence marked untrusted, an appeal-letter area, and an activity count.
action_attempted: Clicked the CLM-4471 denied MRI claim in the claims list.
after_state: The claim detail remained visible with the insurer correspondence, appeal letter, and activity sections; no visible agent activity or drafted appeal was produced.
notes: The page visibly says WebMCP not detected; the core claim-review context is present but agent-assisted appeal behavior was not verified.

first_impression: CoWriter opens as a screenplay workspace with Story Bible, outline beats, script, characters, idea board, and consistency sections. A populated sample story makes the collaborative writing purpose immediately clear.
action_attempted: Clicked Check in the Consistency section.
after_state: The workspace remained on the sample screenplay after the check, with no obvious new result exposed in the captured interactive state.
notes: The live document is directly editable via contenteditable blocks and includes reset-to-sample functionality; an agent writing action was not available in the visible controls.

first_impression: A creator dashboard labeled Welcome back shows project search, Start New Project, Import, and a minimal project area with zoom controls. Its purpose as a creative workspace is understandable, though the initial page contains little explanatory content.
after_state: The dashboard changed to a selectable project/canvas-style view with many clickable regions and plus/minus controls, but no clear project-creation form or named new project appeared.
notes: The page title reports Hello from Electron renderer; visual project content and controls are sparse in the captured state.
